budget_provenance: clean-package (NOT converged, NOT comparable to published numbers)

density.drawn_window: one cell plus 6 bins of periodic margin; one cell outlined
density.normalization: particles per area, divided by the cell mean n = ne/area; a uniform liquid reads 1.0
density.scale_choice: one colour scale per panel, vmin 0, vmax = 99.5th percentile of that panel -- the historical density figure's per-row convention; a shared scale would flatten the liquid control
density.smoothing_kernel: Gaussian, sigma = 0.4 l_B = 1.7820 bins, applied with PERIODIC wrapping

gxy.g_r_nn_definition: maximum of the radial g(r) within half a lattice constant of a_WC = |g1| (the existing estimator's own shell rule)
gxy.normalization: uniform value (ne-1)*dA/area per snapshot, every pair counted in BOTH orientations; g = 1 for a uniform liquid
gxy.scale_choice: common colour scale across both panels, vmin 0
gxy.smoothing: Gaussian, sigma = 1.0 cells (edges held; the window is not a period of the supercell)
gxy.spatial_window: +/- 10.026513 l_B (R_HALF = 4/sqrt(n)); wider than the Wigner-Seitz inradius, so the map keeps periodic IMAGES rather than the minimum image

kappa_mode: physical (rs/sqrt(2)); the Stage-2E rounded regression mode is not used by this recipe
provenance_firewall: Every number in these products comes from the two VMC runs this script started.  This module reads no input file: no checkpoint, no frozen snapshot, no stored observable array, no _diag product and no old PNG is reachable from it.
source_id: not a git repository (no .git at the checkout root); wigner_vmc 0.1.0

sq.bragg_markers: the six first-shell triangular reciprocal-lattice vectors, recomputed from the clean geometry (Torus.wc_shell_vectors), marked with open circles
sq.q0_treatment: the disc |q| < |G1| = 0.448925 is MASKED in the figure.  S(q=0) = ne exactly for every state -- a sum of ne unit phases over ne, which the state cannot enter -- so it is kinematics, not structure.  The mask covers no MEASURED momentum: the allowed torus momenta start at |G1| itself, so every grid point inside the disc is a display sample of the q -> 0 continuum.  What that continuum holds: the 4 points inside |q| < 1/|L1| = 0.061876 still read 35.4 ~ ne, and the rest of the disc has already decayed to O(1).  NOTE q=0 itself is not ON the grid: 160 points over [-Q_HALF, Q_HALF] is an even count, so the smallest |qx| is 0.020073.  The mask is a display convention: the saved S array is raw and mask_q0_disc is stored beside it, so nothing is deleted.
sq.q_grid: 160 x 160, uniform in qx and qy
sq.scale_choice: common colour scale across both panels, vmin 0, vmax set from the 0.75-1.25 |g1| peak annulus alone
